entries.title: I Chronicles 3:1
segments: ¶Now these were David's sons, whose birth took place in Hebron: the oldest Amnon, by Ahinoam of Jezreel; the second Daniel, by Abigail the Carmelite woman;

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:2
segments: The third Absalom, the son of Maacah, the daughter of Talmai, king of Geshur; the fourth Adonijah, the son of Haggith;

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:3
segments: The fifth Shephatiah, by Abital; the sixth Ithream, by Eglah his wife.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:4
segments: He had six sons in Hebron; he was ruling there for seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem for thirty-three years.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:5
segments: And in Jerusalem he had four sons, Shimea and Shobab and Nathan and Solomon, by Bath-shua, the daughter of Ammiel;

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:6
segments: And Ibhar and Elishama and Eliphelet

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:7
segments: And Nogah and Nepheg and Japhia

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:8
segments: And Elishama and Eliada and Eliphelet, nine.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:9
segments: All these were the sons of David, in addition to the sons of his servant-wives; and Tamar was their sister.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:10
segments: ¶And Solomon's son was Rehoboam, Abijah was his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:11
segments: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:12
segments: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:13
segments: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:14
segments: Amon his son, Josiah his son.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:15
segments: And the sons of Josiah: the oldest Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:16
segments: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:17
segments: And the sons of Jeconiah, who was taken prisoner: Shealtiel his son,

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:18
segments: And Malchiram and Pedaiah and Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama and Nedabiah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:19
segments: And the sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei; and the sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:20
segments: And Hashubah and Ohel and Berechiah and Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed, five.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:21
segments: And the sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:22
segments: And the sons of Shecaniah: Shemaiah; and the sons of Shemaiah: Hattush and Igal and Bariah and Neariah and Shaphat, six.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:23
segments: And the sons of Neariah: Elioenai and Hizkiah and Azrikam, three.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:24
segments: And the sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah and Eliashib and Pelaiah and Akkub and Johanan and Delaiah and Anani, seven.
